title.zh: 每日站会 · 进度同步

description.zh: 向同事汇报进展、阻塞和下一步
description.en: Report progress, blockers, and next steps

next_lines.text: The feature is on track, and I'm finishing the main flow.
next_lines.translation: 功能进展顺利，我正在完成主流程。

next_lines.text: I wrapped up the API work and will tackle the UI today.
next_lines.translation: 我完成了 API 部分，今天会处理 UI。

line.text: Hey, quick one — where are we on the feature?
line.translation: 嘿，快速同步一下——那个功能到什么程度了？

next_lines.text: We're on track; the API is done and the UI is in progress.
next_lines.translation: 进展顺利，API 已经完成，UI 还在做。

next_lines.text: The main flow is working, and I'm checking edge cases now.
next_lines.translation: 主流程已经跑通，我现在在检查边界情况。

line.text: Morning! Ready for standup? How's your work going?
line.translation: 早！准备站会了吗？你那边进展如何？

next_lines.text: I'm ready. Here's my progress and what I'll do next.
next_lines.translation: 我准备好了。下面是我的进展和下一步。

next_lines.text: I finished the API work and today I'll focus on the UI.
next_lines.translation: 我完成了 API，今天会集中做 UI。

guidance: 保持站会节奏，每个回答 1-2 句即可。如果用户没说下一步，追问一句                    "What's your plan for today?"。用户表达过于书面时，示范更口语的说法。
